title: Rafael and the Sigil
author: Freya Joubert
blurb: Mirabel Dunmore, a debt-bound temple scribe, has never left the valley where magic cannot follow. But when the crown announces a hunt for anyone with the gift, she discovers that staying invisible was never really an option. To get through this, she must reforge a broken covenant between realms before the usurper's armies reach the free cities.
style: warm, character-driven storytelling with gentle humor
